messages:
maria: Heads-up, we're seeing a sudden spike in 5xxs for hosted inference API region eu-west-1 since the canary rolled out 3m ago. Error distribution looks like 502/504 from gateway. :warning:

jordan: I see it on dashboards — latency up and a big wedge of upstream 504s. Canary tag `route_v2` was promoted to 10% around 2165432070.

alex: Customer tickets just started pouring in for timeouts. Support report: some customers getting billing hits from retries. @support-ana can you quantify impacted tenants?

support-ana: quick count: ~12 paying tenants reported errors through support portal; two filed high-priority incidents. Most show retries and doubled token counts in billing preview.

maria: Repro steps from one tenant: curl to /v1/generate with valid API key returns 504 consistently during the window. Sharing curl:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-base-1","prompt":"test"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```
Response shows HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout.

jordan: grabbing proxy logs for the request ids. Early logs show upstream routing to model-backend-2 but then a 502 from x-forward. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:07:45Z] req=abc123 route=route_v2 upstream=model-backend-2 status=502 err="upstream connection reset"
[2026-03-15T12:07:46Z] req=abc124 route=route_v2 status=504 err="timeout waiting for response"
```

maria: Important: route_v2 changed header normalization — it strips unknown headers for privacy, and I think it accidentally strips `Authorization` for some proxy paths. If auth is removed upstream, backend rejects and retries, causing timeouts.

alex: That would explain retries and billing dupes. Any quick check? Can someone run a curl to the canary host with `--trace-ascii` to confirm headers arriving at backend?

jordan: Running a targeted test against canary machines:
```bash
curl -sS -D - -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX" \ 
  http://canary-eu-west-1.internal/v1/ingest -d '{"ping":1}' --trace-ascii - |& grep Authorization || true
```
Result: header missing in the proxied request.

maria: Confirmed. route_v2 proxy pipeline contains a new filter that erroneously matched `Auth*` header patterns and dropped them. This filter was introduced for a different privacy change.

sre-oncall: Are we confident rollback of the canary flag will stop the spike? We should also disable retries at the edge for the affected routing group to avoid billing duplication until fixed.

maria: Plan: 1) Flip `route_v2` canary back to false for eu-west-1. 2) Temporarily set ``retry.policy.max_attempts=0`` for route group in eu-west-1. 3) Patch filter on dev, validate, then re-enable canary slowly.

ops-bot: @maria initiated feature-flag change: route_v2 -> false for eu-west-1. Change id ff-8421.

deploy-bot: Rollout change applied to 10 hosts in eu-west-1, target 60s window.

jordan: After flip, I'm already seeing 5xx rate drop on the proxy dashboard — tail errors decreasing, p50 latency back to baseline.

support-ana: Noted. I'll message the affected tenants with a short blurb and tell them we rolled back the canary and we're investigating billing artifacts.

alex: For billing: we should compute differential tokens for the window 2165432000-2165432400 for impacted tenants and prepare credits. Who can run the billing diff?

support-ana: I can coordinate with finance but need a list of tenant IDs. I have the 12 from support and can ask for more telemetry from infra.

maria: Patch landed in staging to fix header filter: change regex to only strip `X-Privacy-` prefix instead of `Auth.*`. Will run quick integ tests.

jordan: Can we add a deploy-time integration test that asserts `Authorization` is present in upstream requests? Even a lightweight smoke test would have caught this.

maria: Agreed. Adding a smoke test to canary pipeline. Also adding a SLO alert that tracks auth failures returned from backends to catch regression earlier.

sre-oncall: Monitoring: no further customer-facing spikes for 8m since rollback. Marking incident as mitigated, will keep the channel open while patch gets validated and billing reconciles.

support-ana: Opening customer status thread now. Will follow up with credits plan after finance confirms diff.

alex: Good work moving fast. Postmortem actions: (1) tighten review for header-affecting filters, (2) add smoke test for auth header preservation, (3) automate retry-disable on severe error-rate spike.

maria: I'll start the postmortem doc and link it here when ready.

deploy-bot: Incident note recorded: ff-8421 rollback triggered; follow-up PR: pr/4872.

ops-bot: All changes tracked. Closing action items assigned to maria/jordan/support-ana. :white_check_mark:
